report:
Lung, right upper lobe, segmentectomy

The specimen consists of a right upper lobe segmentectomy specimen (35 g, 70 x 45 x 30 mm). The pleural surface is smooth and glistening. Sectioning reveals a ill-defined, tan-white tumour measuring 18 mm in greatest dimension (18 x 15 x 12 mm), subpleural, 9 mm from the parenchymal margin. The remaining lung parenchyma is spongy and unremarkable.

(1-4) Lesion, entirely embedded.
(5) Parenchymal (staple line) margin.
(6) Lymph node, station 12.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Segmentectomy
- Laterality: Right
- Lobe(s): Upper lobe
- Tumour site: Peripheral
- Tumour size: 18 mm in greatest dimension (18 x 15 x 12 mm)
- Invasive size (lepidic component excluded): Not applicable (in situ)
- Separate tumour nodule(s): Not identified
- Pleural surface (gross): Unremarkable

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Adenocarcinoma in situ (AIS), non-mucinous
- Histologic grade: Not applicable
- Tumour histology:
  The lesion is a purely lepidic proliferation of mildly atypical pneumocytes along intact alveolar walls without stromal, vascular or pleural invasion. Immunohistochemistry: TTF-1 positive.
- Spread through air spaces (STAS): Not identified
- Visceral pleura invasion: Not identified
- Lymphatic and / or vascular invasion: Not identified
- Tumour extension: Not applicable
- Treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy

Margins
- Bronchial margin: Not applicable
- Vascular margin: Not applicable
- Parenchymal margin: Uninvolved by adenocarcinoma in situ (closest distance
  9 mm)

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: 1 examined; 0 involved
  - Stations (involved/examined): 12: 0/1
  - Number examined: 1
  - Number involved: 0

Pathological stage (AJCC 9th edition)
- pTNM: pTis pN0
  - Stage group (if cM0): 0

Additional findings
- Atypical adenomatous hyperplasia

LUNG, right upper lobe, segmentectomy
- ADENOCARCINOMA IN SITU, 18 mm; parenchymal margin clear; see synoptic report
- 0 of 1 regional lymph node involved
